subject.title: feat(gateway): resolve durable profile identity at connection setup

question: Should the shared-gateway identity program require newly durable sender records to retain the prior human-readable email-derived attribution when no profile display name has been configured?
rationale: The branch implements a new durable identity contract, while the profile store intentionally allows unnamed profiles; maintainers need to confirm whether opaque identifiers are acceptable user-facing attribution or whether display continuity is required.

options.title: Preserve readable fallback
options.body: Keep the durable profile ID while projecting an email-derived display fallback for profiles without a configured display name.

options.title: Accept opaque unnamed attribution
options.body: Treat UUID-only sender labels as the intentional default until users configure display names, with explicit release-note and UI confirmation.

recommendation.title: Preserve readable fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the durable profile ID while projecting an email-derived display fallback for profiles without a configured display name.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the adjacent merged identity/profile contract and the open coordination program.
